meta.title: Akra | Custom Furniture Made to Order, Shipped Worldwide
meta.description: Furniture crafted to your design, materials, and finish. From a single piece to full containers, shipped worldwide for importers, designers, and homes.
meta.ogImageAlt: Handcrafted wooden furniture by Akra in warm natural light

about.title: Handcrafted furniture that feels timeless
about.intro: Every piece is made to order in the wood, size and finish you choose. We build it by hand in our workshop and ship it to homes and showrooms around the world.
about.story: Akra grew from Jepara, the town the world sources its furniture from. Not handed down, but built by choice — akar karya, roots and craft. Those roots now reach homes and showrooms worldwide.

customProcess.title: Custom
customProcess.description: Nothing here comes off a shelf. Tell us what you have in mind and we carry it from the first sketch to your door — five phases, one workshop, your design throughout.
customProcess.stepsLabel: How a custom order is made

planning.label: Planning
planning.caption: We start with a conversation: the piece you picture, the wood it should be cut from, the finish, and the room it will live in.
planning.alt: Rust-colored upholstered sofa with deep cushions and an open book resting on the seat

design.label: Design
design.caption: Your idea becomes sketches, then measured drawings, refined together until every proportion and joint feels right.
design.alt: Round wooden dining table with a fluted ceramic vase, surrounded by pale molded chairs

production.label: Production
production.caption: Our artisans build it by hand in the workshop, part by part, checking each joint and surface as the piece comes together.
production.alt: Teak bar table and stools standing in the workshop, timber offcuts stacked along the wall

quality.label: Quality control
quality.caption: Before anything is packed, each piece is checked against the drawings — joinery, finish, moisture and hardware — and whatever falls short goes back to the bench.
quality.alt: Two wooden bar stools on slim white frames in low afternoon light, the grain of each seat picked out in detail

shipping.label: Shipping
shipping.caption: Packed with care, documented for export, and delivered to your door — whether that is one piece or a full container.
shipping.alt: Light ash shelving unit with slatted panels, styled with books and a ceramic pitcher in a finished room

customOrder.title: Tell us what you'd like made
